title: Trinity college
html_source:
The most prestigious university in Dublin, at the time a Protestant-only college. Joyce studied in University College Dublin, a leading Catholic college, and a rival of a sort to Trinity College Dublin.

This rivalry persists to this day, with TCD students supposed to be pretentious, well-to-do types, and UCD offering many country bumpkins on their first foray into Dublin.
